'''Bastiaan Proot''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 92 from Gent, Bel. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010115121000/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/tierfon.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sm-fan">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas (Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
